services.name: Corporate Events
services.desc: Boring, boxed lunches? Lackluster buffets? Hard pass. Your corporate event should reflect your company, and how much you care for and appreciate your team and your clients - not what every other company does. Run-of-the-mill catering be damned! Everyone was mentally preparing for a dry turkey sandwich, stale chips, and a limp pickle. But we make everything on-site, mere minutes before it’s served. So get ready to hear “Ermergherd, this is all so delicious!” alongside weepy, heartfelt thank you’s all. day. long. Book us and chill.
